serverInfo.name: anime-akashic-records-mcp
serverInfo.description: High-precision semantic discovery and Q&A engine over 144,000+ anime, manga, and visual novel works.

tools.name: aar_search
tools.description: Search 144,000+ canonical works by plot memories, premises, or scenes. Supports episode range filters (min_episodes, max_episodes), include_sources, and return_data options.

tools.name: aar_ask
tools.description: Ask narrative and plot questions with grounded AI citations. Supports include_sources and return_data options.

tools.name: aar_find_similar
tools.description: Find semantically and thematically similar works using centroid vector similarity and shared narrative tropes. Supports include_sources and return_data options.

tools.name: aar_stats
tools.description: Retrieve real-time catalog metrics and distribution across all 6 media formats, total chunks, and relation edges.

tools.name: aar_lookup_work
tools.description: Retrieve canonical metadata, relations, and excerpts for a specific work ID.

tools.name: aar_health
tools.description: Check operational status of the Anime Akashic Records API and indexing cluster.

tools.name: aar_advanced_search
tools.description: Granular anime lore search across 7,538 anime, 102,574 episodes, 764,823 timestamped scenes (to the second), and 10,576 story arcs with work, arc, character, and episode range filters. Direct retrieval (not a chatbot).

tools.name: aar_advanced_recommend
tools.description: Granular anime recommendation engine at scene, episode, or story arc granularity using Rocchio vector steering with positive and negative seeds/queries.

tools.name: aar_lore_ask
tools.description: Ask anime scene, episode, or arc questions and receive an LLM-synthesized answer grounded in timestamped scene evidence with exact episode and time citations.

tools.name: aar_arc_index
tools.description: Retrieve the lightweight index of all story arcs (IDs, names, saga names, and episode ranges) for any anime work across 10 ID formats without summaries.
